verdict.rationale: A public online-incorporation service could plausibly offer a programmatic API, so this axis applies. The evidence pack documents only an interactive web flow: Cartão de Cidadão, Chave Móvel Digital or eIDAS authentication, an in-platform form that generates the pacto social, in-platform signing, and MBWay, Multibanco or card payment. Nothing in it mentions a public API, let alone one that matches what the UI can do.
